Definition: from G3708; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance:--sight, vision.
BiblicalUsage: hórasis — sight, vision. That is the whole of it, and it is enough: 3 occurrences, and in Acts and Revelation the meaning never wavers. I keep coming back to the simple reading because the simple reading is the true one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hórasis matters because seeing God is the promise held out to the pure in heart. I hold that the simple reading is the true one, and I will not trade it for a clever one.
RelatedEvents: Pentecost; The Throne Room and the Lamb
